note: Small campground in the woods on Highway 32 near Belleview: fifteen gravel full-hookup sites, back-in and a few pull-through, round one loop with a store and shower house. A week is $240 (7 nights for the price of 6); longer stays are priced on request. Pets limited to two per site. No outside firewood. --Claude
summary: Operator site and Firefly calendar read: 15 full-hookup 30/50A sites (back-in and pull-through), store, bath house, laundry; season March to about November 22; Google 4.8 (45). The $40 rate still rests on the posted weekly special ($240 = 7 for the price of 6); the engine's priced search is behind a reCAPTCHA and was not read, so fees, minimum stay and extra-person charge are unchanged/unknown. Not long-stay in character. Pin fine.
flags: PRICE (not re-quoted - UNREAD): Firefly's priced search (SearchForAvailableUnitClasses) answered 'ErrorCode: Recaptcha' and then asked for a tick-box captcha, in a headless browser on two tries, so no 2026/2027 motorhome quote, fee line, minimum stay or extra-person charge was read. The operator's own pages post no nightly figure; the only posted price is 'Stay for seven nights and receive our special weekly rate of only $240. That's 7 nights for the price of 6', which makes the night $40 - the stored figure, left as it is. Under the US$50 gate on that arithmetic. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py). Fees not rewritten.
MINIMUM STAY: none stated on the site or rules page; the engine's rule could not be read (captcha). Nothing written.

LONG-STAY CHECK (passes): the site sells nightly and weekly and adds 'We offer special prices for long-term stays. Contact us'. The Firefly property calendar shows 10+ of the RV sites free on every night of June and July 2027 and on most nights of November 2026, and the leaf-off imagery shows 2 or 3 rigs on 15 pads. Not seasonal or residential in character.

SEASON: the home page says 'Camping starts on March 1st.' The calendar shows nothing bookable from November 23, 2026 to March 4, 2027 (first open night March 5, 2027). I wrote opens 03-01 (the operator's statement) and closes 11-22 (the calendar's last night); the close is read from one year's calendar, not a stated date.

RIG LENGTH: no length is published; the search form asks for RV length and type. The pads on imagery are long gravel strips (25 m and more), pull-throughs through the middle of the loop. No concern for a 23-ft rig.
RATINGS: Google 4.8 from 45 reviews. RV Life was not checked (the entry carries no rating group).
PRESENCE: working operator site with phone and a live booking engine. Stored phone 573-760-2724 matches the site and Google. Check-in after 1 PM, check-out by 11 AM; office 8:30-5:30.
PIN: stored 37.6931,-90.8763 is at the north end of the site loop, within 40 m of pads - fine. (Google's point 37.69137,-90.87546 is in woods south of the driveway.)
